The conductor, an experienced veteran, appears noticeably older than the station attendant. A station attendant is pushing a luggage cart across the platform while pointing at a departing train. On the luggage cart, there are two boxes and a number of bags. The number of bags is three more than the number of boxes. A mother is holding her child's hand while waiting on the platform. The child is pointing at the train while holding a toy. Behind them, a digital board displays departure times. A security guard is patrolling the station while carrying a radio that is clipped to his belt. A vendor is selling newspapers from a stand positioned between two benches. A backpack is on a nearby seat.
